_doc: Traits of race wave 3. Each is a bag of keys of the trait library (data/traits.json `_doc`). Work speeds are factors on speed (2 = twice as fast). The keys revive_once, line_affinity, split_on_death, counter_melee, no_suit and vacuum_speed come from the race3-hooks track (docs/CONTENT_PLAN.md section 2).

returned.name: Returned
returned.blurb: Came back from the Hollow and does not breathe. The first time they go down, they get up again.

stitched.name: Stitched
stitched.blurb: A bed does nothing for what is stitched together, and a medbay only half as much.

choral_voice.name: Choral voice
choral_voice.blurb: They sing at their work, and everyone else in the room works 15% faster.

hollow_body.name: Hollow body
hollow_body.blurb: A crystal instrument, not a fist: hits a third as hard in a brawl.

gremlin.name: Gremlin
gremlin.blurb: Small enough to walk a 1-wide crawlspace.

scrap_sense.name: Scrap sense
scrap_sense.blurb: Born in Scrap-line walls: repairs and mans Scrap-line parts twice as fast.

many_bodies.name: Many bodies
many_bodies.blurb: A swarm that holds a person's shape, and does not breathe. When brought down it splits in two small bodies that reform if both live.

circuit_kin.name: Circuit kin
circuit_kin.blurb: Made of the thing ion breaks: takes double ion damage.

cutter_torches.name: Cutter torches
cutter_torches.blurb: Torches on both forearms: cuts through doors and walls twice as fast.

boarders_eye.name: Boarder's eye
boarders_eye.blurb: Raised to shoot down a corridor: hits a quarter harder at range.

quill_coat.name: Quill coat
quill_coat.blurb: Anyone who hits them in a brawl is hit back for 10.

proud_back.name: Proud back
proud_back.blurb: A coat of quills does not fit in a suit or armour: they wear none.

drift_born.name: Drift-born
drift_born.blurb: Raised in thin air: takes half the damage in a room with no air.

tail_grip.name: Tail grip
tail_grip.blurb: Quick in thin air: moves half as fast again in a room under 30% air.
